choices.en: bajie was disguised as a servant.
choices.zh: 八戒伪装成了一个仆人。

answer_evidence.quote: Light sparkled, and the servant turned into Bajie.
The monster sighed. "I got a note. It said there was a monkey here, and he was trying to destroy my pagoda."
"He didn't destroy the pagoda. What did he want?"
"But he freed the purple spirit you had captured."
Suddenly Wukong stood before the monster.
"I freed the princess too!"

prompt.zh: 八戒在哪里找到悟空的？

answer_evidence.quote: Bajie hesitated for a moment and then leaped onto a cloud.
He soared through the sky and soon arrived at the Fruit and Flower Mountain.
He found Wukong sitting beside the big waterfall.

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

choices.en: the monster called him a coward.
the monster was scared of him.

answer_evidence.quote: "Oh, I did tell him about you," Bajie lied.
"Really?" Wukong leaned closer.
"What did he say?"
Bajie bit his lip.
"He laughed and said that you're a tiny little coward."

answer_evidence.quote: Then he saw Princess Hundred Flowers and relaxed.
"Why did you think that?" asked the princess.
The princess hesitated.
"You're not going to be happy about this," she said.
There was a flash of light.
Suddenly Wukong stood before the monster.
"I freed the princess too!"
